roles.summary: Received the verified bundle; computed distinct yogurt buyers weeks 1-26 (1,196) against weeks 27-53 (1,136) and who stopped (357); passed the figures to the researcher.
Received the analyst's figures; listed what the 2017 bundle cannot support (stock, margin, consent, other years, any coupon effect) and made no market claim; passed the unknowns to the strategist.
Received figures and unknowns; proposed the availability check before any discount and a consent-aware CRM draft for 345 households; passed the draft to the checker.
Received the draft; re-checked every figure against the metric list, rejected unsupported claims (see the saved example), and passed it to the human.
A named person decides whether to approve the sandbox draft; nothing is sent.

headline.decision: Check availability and assortment of Yogurt before any discount: 345 of the 357 households that stopped buying it still shop here.

options.option: Check availability and assortment first (Product, Place)
options.verdict: First. 96.6% of the households that stopped yogurt still bought something else, so they did not leave the retailer; range and shelf are the cheapest causes to rule out.
options.condition: needs stock and shelf data from the retailer; the bundle has purchases only

options.option: CRM reminder to lapsing households (Promotion, owned channel)
options.verdict: Second, and only for households with consent. 519 households match the simple lapsing rule; how many are reachable is UNKNOWN.
options.condition: consent and contact limits supplied by the client; holdout group kept

options.verdict: Not before a holdout test. Past coupon exposure was not randomized, so any effect is UNKNOWN, and margin and cost are UNKNOWN.
options.condition: margin and cost supplied; a randomized holdout; a named human approves

action_card.segment: Households that bought yogurt in weeks 1-26 and not in weeks 27-53 but still shopped (345); contact only those with recorded consent, and keep a random holdout.

four_ps.product: Check that Yogurt range and facings are complete in the stores these households use
four_ps.price: No change; no discount before a holdout test and a known margin
four_ps.place: Check availability on shelf and in the online range
four_ps.promotion: Owned CRM reminder draft for consented households only (draft, not sent)

action_card.alternative: No spend: run the availability check and collect margin, cost and consent first
action_card.owner: Category manager named by the retailer (CRM operations supports the segment list)
action_card.kpi: Distinct buyers of yogurt in a stated four-week window. Kept apart: expected buyers (a scenario), scenario additional buyers (an assumption) and observed incremental buyers (only after a valid holdout test; UNKNOWN today).

unavailable: stock and availability by store (the bundle has purchases only)
margin and cost per contact (not in the data; supplied by the client or left UNKNOWN)
consent and contact constraints (no consent field; no household can be treated as reachable)
any year other than 2017 (no 2026 sales trend, current campaign or current price is known)
any coupon or campaign effect (exposure was not randomized; the effect is UNKNOWN)
the team's trained purchase model (ConsultAI does not score households)
